slides.headline: Will Your Retirement Paycheck Last as Long as You Do?
slides.subhead: A free class on turning your savings into a dependable monthly paycheck
slides.speaker_script:
"Welcome, everybody. I'm Jordan Ellis, and I'm glad you're here."

[Smile. Look at the camera, not the screen.]

"While people are still joining, type in the chat where you're watching from today."

[Read three or four back by first name and town.]

Timing: about one minute.

slides.headline: You're in the Right Place If…
body: You're within 10 years of retiring, or just retired
You've saved, but don't know what you can safely spend
A market drop makes you nervous
You haven't decided when to take Social Security
slides.speaker_script:
"Let me make sure you're in the right room."

[Read each line slowly.]

"If even one of these is you, you're exactly where you should be."

Timing: about one minute.

slides.headline: Saving a number is not the same as having a paycheck.
slides.speaker_script:
"Here's the line this whole hour turns on."

[PAUSE. Count to three.]

"Saving a number is not the same as having a paycheck."

Timing: about thirty seconds.

slides.headline: What Retirement Has to Cover

big_numbers.label: Years a 65-year-old couple should plan for (fact registry)

slides.speaker_script:
"Two numbers, and then I'll stop with numbers for a while."

[Point at the first figure.]

"[Read F-012 aloud.]"

[BOOKING CALLOUT] "By the way, if you'd like to see these numbers for your own situation, there's a link in the chat to book a Blueprint Session. No need to do it now. Let's keep going."

Timing: about two minutes.

slides.headline: The Three Paycheck Risks

cards.title: Sequence
cards.text: Losses early in retirement hurt more than losses later

cards.title: Longevity
cards.text: Planning for 20 years when you may need 30

cards.title: Inflation
cards.text: The same paycheck buys less every year

slides.speaker_script:
"There are three risks that can shrink a retirement paycheck. Grab your workbook, page three."

[Wait ten seconds.]

"Which one worries you most? Type SEQUENCE, LONGEVITY, or INFLATION in the chat."

[Read a few back.]

Timing: about three minutes.
